say:2:1224656001:0.text: Magister! What can I do for you?
say:2:1224656001:0.source_cn: 哟！魔法师，什么风把你吹来了？
say:2:1224656001:0.male: Magister! What can I do for you?
say:2:1224656001:0.female: Magister! What can I do for you?

say:3:1224656002:1.text: Hugin, Lucca said the escaped Water Wights might start a fire here!
say:3:1224656002:1.source_cn: 呼金，卢卡说越狱的水鬼帮可能会在你这纵火！

say:4:1224656003:1.text: Muahahaha! Don't worry, I've prepared for it.
say:4:1224656003:1.source_cn: 呼哈哈哈哈！不用担心，我早有准备。

say:5:1224656004:1.text: I have the recipe for a special fireproof coating! But now, I still need one more material.
say:5:1224656004:1.source_cn: 防火涂料——独家秘方！不过，现在缺个东西。

say:6:1224656005:1.text: I already had Sinbad prepare all the material for you ages ago. Everything's here; feel free to use anything you need!
say:6:1224656005:1.source_cn: 早就让辛巴达帮我把材料都备好了，今天可算是把你这个大忙...
say:6:1224656005:1.male: I already had Sinbad prepare all the material for you ages ago. Everything's here; feel free to use anything you need!
say:6:1224656005:1.female: I already had Sinbad prepare all the material for you ages ago. Everything's here; feel free to use anything you need!
